# Release notes

Checkout abandoned 18% of carts after we added a third address field, so we
removed it on 2026-10-02. Abandonment fell to 11% the following week.

Remote work didn't cut our headcount. It did cut hallway debugging, and the
Berlin team now posts blockers in the shared doc before 10:00.

Use this for weekly team notes. Don't use it for a grant abstract until a
person has checked every citation.
